name: Zell Education

about.text: Established in 2015, Zell education is making a difference between the existing education system and the required skills. Equipping candidates with the relevant practical skills in their field was the first and foremost reason to start this learning platform. It has centers in metro cities like Delhi, Mumbai, and Banglore.

This learning center emphasizes providing global recognition to accounting professionals through its training programs for ACCA, CPA, CFA, FRM, and US CMA. Zell Education has been authorized by the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) to provide training for its global certification exam. The institution has now expanded its network by collaborating with some authentic universities not just in India but around the globe. Some of its collaborators include Bennett University, KC College, Mumbai Educational Trust, etc.

If you are planning on appearing for globally recognized certified accounting exams of ACCA, CFA, US CMA, FRM, etc. Zell education might serve as your mentor in this journey. Considering the complexity of these exams, you need proper guidance and support for their preparations and this can be gained by joining a learning center or coaching institute. So, why settle for a basic one when you have the option of the best in the industry? Zell Education is a Platinum Learning Approved Partner by ACCA, to provide training to learners aspiring to clear the ACCA exam.

Zell Education is renowned for providing extensive training sessions delivered by industry experts in the field of finance and accounting. Moreover, the support services provided by this education platform have transformed the lives of many learners by helping them with the right guidance at the right time. These services included an automated LMS portal, job readiness services, 1:1 mentorship sessions with student coordinators, relevant learning resources, etc.

facts: Zell Education delivers high-quality content for the preparation of various accounting certifications in online mode.
Zell was founded in 2015 with a vision to transform professional education.
It offers professional training for ACCA, CFA, US CMA, FRM, diploma in IFRS, and other exams of financing and accounting majors.
With 100% placement support, its exam prep training has made many aspirants clear the globally recognized accounting certifications and get placed at the big 4 firms.

Zell is partnered with Bennett University, KC College, Mumbai Educational Trust, and other reputed organizations. Recently, it has also collaborated with Becker Professional Education for the CPA (US) and CMA (US), FRM courses.
The content of the program is delivered through live lectures by industry experts and ACCA members.
This learning platform is known for offering experiential learning through its case studies, projects, quizzes, and assignments.
It enriches your knowledge with an updated curriculum and exclusive study materials, and practice questions & mock tests.
LMS access, recorded lectures, soft and hard copies of study materials, unit and mock tests, and registration support are some additional support that you get at this learning center.
Zell Education is a Platinum Learning Approved Partner by ACCA, to provide training for ACCA exam prep.

emi.text: All of Zell Education's online accounting training courses come with EMI options. One of the things that draws prospective applicants to these online training courses is the "No Cost EMI" option. To be aware of all the terms and conditions, you can simply check the payment options and other transactional information on Zell's official website.

admission.text: The admission process to join a particular training program at Zell is quite simple and sorted. Below are some steps that will make you enroll in the program in just a few minutes.
Step 1: Look through the extensive library of programs offered by Zell Education.
Step 2: Provide your personal and educational details on the online application form.
Step 3: Depending on the program, applicants can be required to do an interview or an assessment.
Step 4: The completed application, assessment, and interview outcomes are evaluated for admission eligibility.
Step 5: Notification of admission status to applicants.
Step 6: Selected applicants finish the enrollment process by submitting the necessary documentation and finishing the necessary procedures.
Step 7: To make tuition more affordable, investigate flexible payment options like EMIs.
Step 8: After enrolling, learners can start their education journey with Zell.

examination.text: Case studies, assignments, project review reports, and theoretical term-end exams are all components of the Zell Education assessment procedure. All assignments and projects are conducted and submitted in the online format. Exams will be given online using proctored procedures at the LMS of this learning center. This ensures the integrity and fairness of the exam's administration. In addition, practice tests, quizzes, and mock tests are part of routine internal evaluations.

faqs.q: What is Zell Education’s DipIFRS program?
faqs.a: Diploma in International Financial Reporting (DipIFRS) is offered by the globally recognized Association of Certified Chartered Accountants. Zell provides a 3-month coaching to clear this exam.

faqs.q: Who are the mentors at Zell Education?
faqs.a: Industry experts serving in the finance and accounting field and ACCA members are the trainers at Zell Education.

faqs.q: Who can enroll in the training certification courses of Zell Education?
faqs.a: Zell offers different levels of preparation courses for globally accepted accounting certifications for 10th, 12th, and professional categories of learners. Thus, you can enroll in any of the training programs based on your qualifications.

faqs.q: Does Zell provide coaching for FRM?
faqs.a: Zell education is one of the finest institutions for accounting exam preparations. It offers a range of training courses for ACCA, FRM, CFA, US CMA, and DipIFRS.

faqs.q: Does Zell Education provide certification for ACCA?
faqs.a: No, Zell Education is a learning center that is approved by ACCA to provide training for its official exam.

faqs.q: Does Zell Education offer offline courses?
faqs.a: Zell is known for providing online training courses for globally accepted accounting certifications like ACCA, US CMA, CFA, FRM, etc.

faqs.q: Is any placement support provided by Zell Education?
faqs.a: Zell provides 100% placement assistance to its learners via mock interviews, practice papers, and group discussions that prepare them for final exams and interview sessions.
